messages.text: Decided: keep `theming.install: personal.install` and the unused `INSTALL=` line as they are (because they are outside this task's scope; theming now simply is not in `make install`, since it has no installer). Decided: `make <name>.install` for a name with no installer still echoes "Installed <name>" and does not fail (because `make install` on mac/ubuntu includes dirs that have an installer for only one OS, e.g. java, and failing there would break it).

Decided while you were away: accepted the executor's two calls, `theming.install: personal.install` and the unused `INSTALL=` line left alone (out of scope), and `make <name>.install` not failing for a name with no installer (java has one for one OS only); with the message changed from "Installed <name>" to one that says there was no installer, since nothing was installed.

Decided while you were away: landing `69001af36476`, check green (because the cause is found and fixed: `.PHONY` listed `$(MAKECMDGOALS)`, so pattern rules were skipped; `install` now comes from `wildcard */install*.sh`, so `tasks/` and `scripts/` are no longer installed; regression checks in `task check` failed on the old code). The "Installed <name>" message for a name with no installer is left as is, cosmetic; change it when that Makefile is next touched.
